sources.title: Ultralytics YOLO26: Unified Real-Time End-to-End Vision Models
sources.snippet: We present Ultralytics YOLO26, a unified real-time vision model family that addresses these limitations through coordinated architecture and training advances. Architecturally, YOLO26 uses a dual-head design for native NMS-free end-to-end inference and removes DFL entirely, yielding a lighter head with unconstrained regression range.
